professionalSummary: Data Scientist with over seven years of applied data science experience focused on controlled experiments and product analytics.
Specialized in designing and validating statistical methods for A/B test reporting, including variance reduction techniques such as CUPED.
Experienced in sequential testing, having authored internal guides on mixture sequential probability ratio tests and explained stopping rules to stakeholders.
Proficient in communicating methodology through public documentation and supporting solutions engineers on technical customer calls.
experienceHighlights: Implemented CUPED variance reduction in Hartwell Apps’ experiment reporting service and validated it with A/A simulations over twelve months of historical tests (src_972d56e96c87).
Authored an internal guide to the mixture sequential probability ratio test used by Hartwell’s experimentation dashboard, detailing stopping rules and horizon requirements (src_8b718356241c).
Analyzed pricing‑page and onboarding experiments at Corbel Software, reporting results to the growth team each sprint (src_12c741c24ef4).
Conducted weekly office hours for product managers, reviewing analysis plans before launch (src_50080721c4d2).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Published methodology note on Hartwell’s developer blog explaining confidence interval computation with CUPED, including A/A simulation chart and code snippet (src_c1c07748e2e9).
